name: Ethchlorvynol
summary: Sedative-hypnotic medication made in the 1950's. The drug was used for treatment of short-term insomnia (two weeks).

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: Ethchlorvynol is a GABAA receptor positive allosteric modulator with hypnotic and sedative properties, first developed by Pfizer in the 1950s.

uses.text: Ethchlorvynol was indicated to treat insomnia and was widely prescribed in the 1960s and 1970s. Its exact mechanism of action is not fully established, but it appears to depress the central nervous system through modulation of GABAA receptors, in a manner broadly similar to barbiturates. Prescriptions had fallen significantly by 1990 as newer hypnotics considered safer in overdose, particularly benzodiazepines, became standard of care.

sideEffects.text: Along with expected sedative effects such as relaxation and drowsiness, reported adverse effects of ethchlorvynol include gastrointestinal upset (nausea and vomiting), dizziness, blurred or altered vision, numbness or tingling, and unsteadiness or impaired coordination. Hypersensitivity reactions such as skin rash have also been reported.

zhHansOther: 乙氯維諾, 乙氯戊烯炔醇
summaryZh: 乙氯維諾，又名乙氯戊烯炔醇、氯乙基戊烯炔醇，是一種GABA能鎮靜催眠藥，用於短期治療失眠。它於1950年代初由輝瑞公司合成，後於1956年由雅培公司上市銷售。
summaryZhHans: 乙氯维诺，又名乙氯戊烯炔醇、氯乙基戊烯炔醇，是一种GABA能镇静催眠药，用于短期治疗失眠。它于1950年代初由辉瑞公司合成，后于1956年由雅培公司上市销售。

fact.en: Ethchlorvynol, sold as Placidyl, is a small molecule with an unusual mix of features for a drug: a carbon to carbon triple bond and a double bond carrying a chlorine atom. It is no longer made in the United States.
fact.zh: 乙氯維諾（商品名 Placidyl）是一個小分子，具有藥物中少見的組合：一個碳碳三鍵，以及一個帶氯原子的雙鍵。美國已不再生產這種藥。
fact.zhHans: 乙氯维诺（商品名 Placidyl）是一个小分子，具有药物中少见的组合：一个碳碳三键，以及一个带氯原子的双键。美国已不再生产这种药。
